title: Man linked to Pickton killed by Ontario police
article: A man linked by evidence to Robert Pickton's B.C. farm was shot dead by three police officers in a posh Ontario neighbourhood.
Steve Remian, 38, had exited a car at a park in Oakville when police opened fire at 2:30 a.m. Saturday.
Officers had followed his car after receiving a report of a man, possibly armed, behaving oddly at a Tim Hortons.
A rifle was recovered at the shooting scene.

Remian's name surfaced in the Pickton trial in March. His name was found on a suitcase in the workshop where body parts of two of Pickton's alleged victims were found in a freezer. A hair DNA linked to Remian turned up on a blanket.
The jury in Pickton's murder trial was still deliberating Monday.
